channel.title: M365 Roadmap Tracker — A Guide to Cloud & AI
channel.description: Daily Microsoft 365 roadmap updates — new features, status changes, and AI summaries

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription for Teams Call Queues
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Administrators can enable automatic recording and transcription for Teams call queues. When enabled, calls answered by calling representatives are automatically recorded without manual action. item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Localized Default Mark and Notify Email Template
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Localized default email templates for Mark and Notify in Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will improve user notifications in their preferred language. This affects end users reporting messages. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Defender for Office 365

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Planner: Available in Outlook
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Planner in Outlook brings all your tasks, plans, and the new Planner Agent directly into your inbox, so you can manage work where you already work. (GA: August CY2026) — Planner

item.title: [NEW] Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
item.description: [NEW] Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web. This update also introduces Goals in basic plans. (GA: September CY2026) — Planner

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
item.description: [NEW] Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes will provide administrators with explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, helping ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational requirements. (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Teams: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring & troubleshooting for meetings and calls across the organisation
item.description: [NEW] Administrators can monitor meeting and call health across the organization, uncover recurring patterns, and proactively troubleshoot issues impacting users in both active and completed meetings and calls. (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.description: [NEW] Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings. (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage: New left navigation controls — collapse, resize, increased favorites cap, and reorder favorites capabilities
item.description: [NEW] We're introducing a set of left-navigation improvements in Viva Engage on the web that give people more control over their navigation pane. item.title: [NEW] Outlook: Filter Messages by Events

item.title: [NEW] Outlook: Insert Signature Image from OneDrive
item.description: [NEW] Users can now insert images into their email signature directly from OneDrive, in addition to the device photo library. (GA: August CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Teams: Additional health signals available for Teams Rooms on Android on Pro Management Portal
item.description: [NEW] Expanded Pro Management Portal (PMP) health monitoring for Teams Rooms on Android by surfacing device health signals including storage health, Teams meeting app, calendar sync, secondary display health and network. When issues are detected, PMP will automatically generate actionable alerts and suppo (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot memory in Researcher
item.description: [NEW] Copilot memory within Researcher brings forward relevant context from your past interactions—helping ground insights, personalize outputs, and reduce repetitive setup as you explore complex topics. (GA: November CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] When users are signed in with a work account, some Microsoft 365 sites (for example, microsoft.com, cloud.microsoft, and microsoft365.com) may open authentication pop-up windows to Microsoft sign-in endpoints such as login.microsoftonline.com, login.live.com, or login.microsoft.com. item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Users can now highlight content and ask Microsoft Copilot for specific help on that selection, improving the relevance of responses. This affects all users of Copilot. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.description: [UPDATED] We are introducing file archiving support in SharePoint Online, utilizing this feature administrators can seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. item.description: [UPDATED] Teams rooms on Windows and Android, Panels and Teams Phones now supports Entra Resource Accounts for secure, passwordless sign-in that separates device and user identities. item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge: v.151 - Passkey Sync for Enterprise Users
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge is introducing support for passkey synchronization for enterprise users, enabling secure, passwordless authentication across devices. item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplified design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] A refreshed design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot web and desktop app simplifies the user experience to drive engagement with Copilot. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.description:

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies
item.description: Microsoft Purview expands DLP protection to Copilot and PC devices, allowing custom policies for Recall snapshots. This affects Purview admins and Intune admins managing these devices. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated chat-first design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
item.description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will receive a chat-first design update, improving user interface and navigation. This affects all mobile app users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplifying Content in the Input Box
item.description: The Input Box in Microsoft 365 Copilot will simplify content insertion by displaying it as a pill, not repeating it in prompts. This affects users of the Copilot app. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)
